tools.name: hoi4.focus_inspect
tools.title: Inspect focus trees
tools.description: Inspect focus trees and continuous palettes, including source references, diagnostics, and layout.

previous.description: Prior deterministic focus layout used to stabilize unchanged positions.

tools.name: hoi4.focus_render
tools.title: Render focus review artifacts
tools.description: Render focus HTML, SVG, JSON, and source maps. Use hoi4.focus_raster for decoded icons and PNG.

tools.name: hoi4.focus_raster
tools.title: Rasterize focus review artifacts
tools.description: Render focus PNG with decoded source icons; also returns HTML, SVG, and JSON.

tools.name: hoi4.focus_rewrite
tools.title: Create or clean up focus content
tools.description: Create or compact a focus tree or palette from a complete plan. Use treeId for existing trees and createIfMissing for new files.

plan.description: Complete national or continuous focus plan.

tools.name: hoi4.gui_inspect
tools.title: Inspect scripted GUI
tools.description: Inspect GUI sources and scenarios.

scenario.description: GUI preview scenario; optional date and controls {stateId: controllerTag}.

items.description: GUI preview scenario; optional date and controls {stateId: controllerTag}.

tools.name: hoi4.gui_render
tools.title: Render scripted GUI artifacts
tools.description: Render GUI states, resolutions, scenarios, hierarchy, comparisons, and diagnostics.

scenario.description: GUI preview scenario; optional date and controls {stateId: controllerTag}.

uiScale.description: In-game UI scale for this resolution. Use 1 at 1920x1080; do not use it to enlarge an artifact.

items.description: GUI preview scenario; optional date and controls {stateId: controllerTag}.

comparisonScenario.description: GUI preview scenario; optional date and controls {stateId: controllerTag}.

sourceBaseline.description: Previous mod-owned .gui source for a matched source comparison using the requested scenario.

tools.title: Create or clean up scripted GUI
tools.description: Apply one validated source, helper, or exact-patch GUI package. Text dependencies use additionalFiles; binary art stays workspace-referenced.

scenario.description: GUI preview scenario; optional date and controls {stateId: controllerTag}.

tools.name: hoi4.map_inspect
tools.title: Inspect HOI4 map
tools.description: Validate and inspect the complete map, or use lookupOnly for bounded coordinate and entity lookups.

provinceIds.description: Export row runs for up to 32 province IDs

tools.name: hoi4.map_render
tools.title: Render map inspection artifacts
tools.description: Render searchable full-map PNG, JSON, and HTML, or a reusable source-coordinate tile.

tools.name: hoi4.map_rewrite
tools.title: Create or clean up map content
tools.description: Apply map creation, edits, and ID swaps with visual and semantic evidence.

tools.name: hoi4.reference_search
tools.title: Search local HOI4 references
tools.description: Search bounded, cited sections of the configured offline wiki and installed game documentation.

tools.name: hoi4.reference_read
tools.title: Read cited HOI4 reference section
tools.description: Read at most 80 lines from one revision-bound local documentation section.

tools.name: hoi4.reference_context
tools.title: Get HOI4 task references
tools.description: Return a compact bundle of offline wiki and installed game documentation citations for a modding surface.

tools.name: hoi4.source_lookup
tools.title: Look up HOI4 source symbol
tools.description: Find exact Clausewitz definitions, override status, a bounded source block, and indexed usages in the configured game and mod.

tools.name: hoi4.event_inspect
tools.title: Inspect event chains
tools.description: Scan, find roots, trace, explain paths, inspect state flow, lint, or assess impact. Full source-linked reports are resources.

helperExpansion.description: Bounded helper paths; opaque continuationUri resumes the same source and roots. See docs/events.md.

tools.name: hoi4.event_render
tools.title: Render event chains
tools.description: Render deterministic JSON, SVG, PNG, and optional HTML for an event-chain view. Complete artifacts retain source links.

tools.name: hoi4.event_compare
tools.title: Compare event chains
tools.description: Compare cached, artifact-backed, current, or in-memory proposed event graphs, optionally selecting one downstream chain. Full changes and explicit selection coverage are resources.

before.description: Cached revision or graph artifact URI.

after.description: Cached revision or graph artifact URI.

tools.name: hoi4.impact_inspect
tools.title: Inspect cross-system impact
tools.description: Trace definitions and consumers of symbols or changed source across HOI4 systems. Proposed sources are analyzed in memory; full revision-bound evidence is linked.

tools.name: hoi4.decision_inspect
tools.title: Inspect decisions and missions
tools.description: Inventory decisions or evaluate declared actor and target scenarios for gates, payment, lifecycle, and proposed-source differences. Full evidence is linked.

tools.name: hoi4.mechanic_test
tools.title: Test declared mechanic steps
tools.description: Interpret bounded, source-backed effect steps on isolated declared state and check typed invariants. Unsupported effects remain unresolved; no game or mod source is changed.

test.description: Versioned declared scenario, explicit effect steps, and typed assertions. See docs/mechanics.md.

tools.name: hoi4.package_check
tools.title: Check package connections
tools.description: Check a declarative package manifest against active definitions, references, registrations, localisation, assets, and required suite cases.

manifest.description: Declarative definitions, calls, registrations, localisation, assets, and required cases. See docs/mechanics.md.

tools.name: hoi4.scenario_test
tools.title: Run scenario suite
tools.description: Run named inline or workspace-relative cases through bounded typed read-only domain services. Large suites return an authenticated continuation.

suite.description: Named mechanic, package, or fixed read-only tool cases. See docs/mechanics.md.

tools.name: hoi4.tech_inspect
tools.title: Inspect technology trees
tools.description: Scan, discover folders, trace, explain, inspect unlocks or bonuses, lint, and assess impact.

helperExpansion.description: Bounded helper paths; opaque continuationUri resumes the same source and roots. See docs/technology.md.

tools.name: hoi4.tech_compare
tools.title: Compare technology trees
tools.description: Compare cached, resource-backed, current, or proposed source graphs without writes.
